name: plan-build-review
summary: For features. Plan the change, build it, review it, and update the docs.

roles.name: planner
roles.job: Turns the request into a plan: the changes, the interface, the edge cases and the tests.

roles.name: builder
roles.job: Writes the code and the tests from the plan.

roles.name: reviewer
roles.job: Checks the code against the request, line by line. Finds missing cases.

roles.name: doc-writer
roles.job: Updates the user docs so that they match the new behavior.

steps.do: Read the request and the code. Write a plan with a list of acceptance checks.
Write the code and tests for each acceptance check.
Update the README for the new behavior.
Check each acceptance check against the code and the tests. Send problems back to the builder.

rules: The builder and the doc-writer can work at the same time.
The reviewer must not be the builder.
Repeat build and review until the reviewer accepts the change.
